description: variant-fixed's copybook read odoslide, in a variable-length dataset: the table holds as many entries as the record's own count states, the item behind it moves with that count, and every entry still chooses its own arm. Three records, of three entries, one and two, so the extent is data rather than a constant and a consumer that read the table at the declared maximum would take ADR-TAIL out of bytes belonging to the next record. The second record's single entry is a table of one and is written as an array all the same. The pair with variant-fixed is the entry's point: one copybook, two readings, two descriptors that differ in the table's repetition and in the framing that follows from it, and nothing in either file to disagree with the wrong one.
